evidence.why: Item price is accepted as client input rather than looked up from an authoritative product record.

evidence.snippet: const calculatedTotal = parsed.data.cartItems.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.price * item.quantity, 0);
evidence.why: Total is recomputed from client-supplied per-item prices, not re-derived from server-side product prices, so billing amount is still attacker-controlled.
Stripe charge amount is based on the client-supplied prices used to compute calculatedTotal.
